{{Quote|That's not the sort of mission the Whiplash usually involves itself in. We protect people, extricate them from unhealthy situations, find them safe passage offworld. We don't indulge people's vendettas.|Jax Pavan|<ref name="Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>}}
The '''Whiplash''', was a resistance movement located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that was formed following the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It specialized in removing people, specifically Jedi and political refugees, from Coruscant to other planets away from the Empire's reach.

==Organization==
Members of Whiplash were extremely careful to not reveal their identity to outsiders. Any meetings that would take place were done with the utmost secrecy. At times, Whiplash operators would not communicate with each other for months as they worked to undermine the Empire on Coruscant. As of [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]] [[Thi Xon Yimmon]] was the leader of the organization. Other notable Whiplash members include: [[Den Dhur]], [[Dejah Duare]], [[Pol Haus]], [[Kars Korthos]], [[Jax Pavan]], [[Lex Rogger]], [[Nick Rostu]], [[Haninum Tyk Rhinann]], [[Tuden Sal]], [[Kajin Savaros]], and [[Laranth Tarak]].

==History==
As the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] drew to a close, the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] formally issued the [[Declaration of a New Order]] which abolished the Republic and formed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Along with this, Palpatine issued [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] which condemned the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as traitors. This began the Imperial [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|invasion]] and destruction of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], and the systematic [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|execution]] of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

As the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] entered the Temple, the [[Temple employee]]s fled though most of the [[Temple Security Force]] was wiped out. The [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] occupied the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] and the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] as [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] patrolled the streets of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] along side [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. Along with the purging of the Jedi Order, Palpatine issued a [[Emperor's purge|purge of the government]] and the military including the arrests of many of the [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] who had signed the [[Petition of 2000]].

Those who survived the initial days of the formation of the Empire formed themselves into the Whiplash, a secret resistance group whose mission was to help Jedi and political refugees get off of Coruscant. Among the survivors was Jedi master [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]], who was hiding in lower levers of Coruscant. He was found by Imperial stormtroopers who defeated him but were unable to give a killing blow due to arrival of whiplash members. 

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Whiplash remained active. Its operatives rarely made direct contact with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]], much less joined its operations, but the two organizations shared information and resources whenever possible. The Rebel Alliance desperately needed intelligence from the heart of Imperial power, and often relied on fugitives too notorious for Whiplash to shelter. In return, trusted smugglers and Rebel agents provided Whiplash with supply runs, communications, and occasional exfiltrations.<ref name=":0">[[Desperate Allies|''Desperate Allies'']]</ref> 

Despite this cooperation, meetings between the two groups’ agents were always tense, as the danger of betrayal was greatest at the very center of Imperial authority.<ref name=":0" />

Although their purpose was transporting beings off Coruscant, the Whiplash organization took part in some open conflicts as well, including the [[Battle in the Imperial Security Bureau]].
